structures.overall_structure: The Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni alloy SLM-printed at 90 W mainly comprises the austenite (γ-Fe(M)) phase without any α-Fe(M) phase (fully austenitic by XRD); the transverse cross-section consists of fine equiaxed grains with random orientations.

unmapped_findings: The P-90 sample exhibited more-dominant ductile dimple fractures (Fig. 13(b)), indicative of superior yield strength, tensile strength, and ductility; a spherical unfused powder particle (lack of fusion) is visible on its fracture surface.
FWHM of the (111) diffraction peak for P-90 = 0.274 (vs 0.289 for P-70 and 0.263 for P-110), implying the average grain size of SLM-printed samples gradually increases with increasing energy density.
The P-90 (90 W) surface SEM morphology is smoother than P-70, with faint parallel melt-track striations and scattered spherical particles still flagged as lack of fusion (Fig. 11(b)).
P-90 laser energy density = 75.00 J/mm³, with P-70 and P-90 sharing all SLM parameters and differing only in laser power.
